How It Works

From Story to Set

Whether you choose a collection or commission something custom, here's how a TileSmith set comes to life.

1

Tell Your Story

Choose a themed collection, or tell us about the place, passion, or heritage you want your set to celebrate.

2

We Design

Our artists translate your theme into 166 individual tile designs — bold, high-contrast artwork in our signature style.

3

We Print

Each tile is 3D printed layer by layer in PLA+ at 600-micron resolution. No shortcuts, no outsourcing.

4

We Finish

Every tile is hand-inspected and finished. Your set ships in a matte black case with a card telling its story.

About TileSmith

Crafted, Not
Mass-Produced

TileSmith started with a simple question: why do all mahjong sets look the same? The game has been bringing people together for over a century, but the tiles themselves rarely reflect the people playing with them.

We changed that. Every TileSmith set is 3D printed and hand-finished in-house. No outsourcing, no compromises. Each of the 166 tiles carries a piece of a story — your story — rendered in our signature bold, high-contrast graphic style.
